drafts.subject1: NCT07777484: Early-phase PK and dose characterization
drafts.email1:
Hi Cody,

Saw NCT07777484, your Phase 1 study of TRB-001 in Parkinson's Disease.

Phase 1 CNS programs carry the extra burden of showing target engagement past the blood-brain barrier, which is hard to argue without central-compartment modeling. There's enough here to build the PopPK model while the study runs instead of piecing it together afterward.

We do pharmacometrics and clinical pharmacology at PumasAI, and several of our team came from the FDA, Novartis and BMS. We've supported more than 75 regulatory submissions across six agencies, including 37 Phase 3 programs. On a study like this we'd usually cover NCA, PopPK, dose-escalation modeling, and the clinical pharmacology write-up.

Worth a short call?
